description: This file defines a sealed class 'InterlockedFlag' used for thread-safe state management via atomic operations, specifically utilizing Interlocked.CompareExchange to manage its internal value.

classes.name: InterlockedFlag
classes.description: A thread-safe class for managing a simple set/unset flag, using atomic compare-and-swap operations.

methods.name: InterlockedFlag
methods.description: Constructor initializing the internal value to 0.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Property indicating whether the flag has been set.

methods.name: TrySet
methods.description: Attempts to set the flag atomically; returns true if successful.

methods.name: ThrowNotInitializedIfSet
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException if the flag is set.

methods.name: ThrowDisposedIfSet
methods.description: Throws ObjectDisposedException if the flag is set, given a type parameter.
